clues.it: Paolo era nella 1ª riga, accanto a una palma in vaso e a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 1st row, beside a potted palm and north of Carla.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 6ª colonna e accanto a una palma in vaso, ma non era accanto a un pianoforte a coda.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 6th column and beside a potted palm, but was not beside a grand piano.

clues.it: Carla era nella 2ª colonna, accanto a un lampadario e a ovest di Irene.
clues.en: Carla was in the 2nd column, beside a chandelier and west of Irene.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 4ª riga, accanto a il bancone della reception e in una stanza diversa da Carla.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 4th row, beside the reception desk and in a different room from Carla.

clues.it: Vito era nella 4ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e a ovest di Dario.
clues.en: Vito was in the 4th column, in the 5th row and west of Dario.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Irene era a nord di Dario e al Ristorante.
clues.en: Irene was north of Dario and in the Restaurant.

clues.it: Dario era a ovest di Olga e al Ristorante.
clues.en: Dario was west of Olga and in the Restaurant.

clues.it: Olga era in una stanza diversa da Paolo e da sola nella Sala da Ballo.
clues.en: Olga was in a different room from Paolo and alone in the Ballroom.

clues.it: Anna era nella 8ª colonna e nella Suite Reale, ma non era accanto a un pianoforte a coda.
clues.en: Anna was in the 8th column and in the Royal Suite, but was not beside a grand piano.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 1ª colonna e nella 11ª riga, ma non era accanto a un tavolo da biliardo.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 1st column and in the 11th row, but was not beside a billiard table.
